A.headline: Agilent grows revenue 9.6% with a 30% operating margin and guides fiscal 2027 EPS up about 7% to $6.73–6.86

ADI.headline: Analog Devices posts record revenue up 42%, but a flat first-quarter outlook sends the shares down 17%

ADSK.headline: Autodesk grows revenue 17% with a 39% operating margin and raises full-year targets, but billings lag at 12%

ALC.headline: Alcon: core EPS up 15% on wider margins, but cataract-lens sales slip in the US under competitive pressure; shares fall 4%

AMAT.headline: Applied Materials: revenue up 53% and earnings nearly doubled, with another record quarter guided

B.headline: Barrick: adjusted EPS up 41% on high gold prices, Mali mine back at full speed, but costs per ounce jump 24%

BABA.headline: Alibaba: cloud growth accelerates to 53% and profit triples, but AI spending pushes free cash flow deeper into the red

BAP.headline: Credicorp: ROE near 20% on 15% loan growth and a 6.9% margin, with extra provisions set aside for a “very strong” El Niño

BN.headline: Brookfield Corporation: distributable earnings up 16% per share, $25 billion raised and buybacks near $900 million this year

CEG.headline: Constellation Energy: EPS of $5.06 beats by 30% and guidance rises again as Google and Amazon sign up for nuclear power; shares up 10%

CRWD.headline: CrowdStrike posts record new recurring revenue and agrees to buy Zscaler in a $43.9 billion all-stock deal

CSCO.headline: Cisco: fastest growth in 15 years, yet the shares fell 5% — next quarter’s guide is below this one

DELL.headline: Dell doubles revenue to a record $54.9 billion and raises its full-year outlook to $202 billion

DIS.headline: Disney: adjusted EPS up 59% in a quarter flattered by an extra week, with double-digit growth promised again

DLTR.headline: Dollar Tree beats with 4.6% comparable sales growth and raises its earnings outlook; shares jump 11%

EC.headline: Ecopetrol: profit up 86% on record refining margins and higher oil prices, with Brazil’s Brava Energia added in September

ESLT.headline: Elbit Systems: revenue up 17%, EPS up 30% and a record $33 billion backlog driven by European orders; shares rise 6%

FERG.headline: Ferguson: non-residential sales up 15% on data-centre and infrastructure projects; guidance raised and shares jump 11%

FNV.headline: Franco-Nevada: earnings up a third on $4,250 gold despite 6% fewer ounces; Cobre Panamá talks move a step closer

HD.headline: Home Depot: sales up 4.9% and comps positive, but full-year earnings growth is guided to about 2%

HMC.headline: Honda: half-year profit up 66% as motorcycles earn ¥439 billion, but the car business still loses money and the forecast implies a weak second half

HPE.headline: HPE grows revenue 50% to a record $14.5 billion and raises its outlook, but the shares fall 16%

HPQ.headline: HP grows revenue 9% as AI PCs reach almost 60% of shipments, and the stock jumps 11.5% despite a cautious outlook

INTU.headline: Intuit: earnings up 56% on 12% revenue growth, and Mailchimp is being sold

IX.headline: ORIX: half-year profit triples to ¥856 billion on a ¥796 billion paper gain from Toshiba’s Kioxia stake; underlying income up 4%

JD.headline: JD.com: profit up 58% as food-delivery losses shrink and revenue returns to growth, but the shares fall 8% on weak momentum

KB.headline: KB Financial: nine-month profit up 10% to ₩5.6 trillion with fees up 38%, as buybacks keep shrinking the share count

KEYS.headline: Keysight: revenue up 41% and orders up 53% on AI networking demand, yet the shares fall 7% after a record year

KKR.headline: KKR: record fee earnings up 27% and a $2 billion gain coming from the USI sale, as the firm returns record cash to clients

LOW.headline: Lowe’s: the $3.10 EPS ‘beat’ includes 34 cents of tariff refunds — underneath, earnings fell

MDT.headline: Medtronic grows 6.5% organically as cardiac ablation surges 58%, but only reiterates its full-year outlook

MFG.headline: Mizuho: half-year profit up 30% to ¥896 billion; full-year forecast raised 14% to ¥1.6 trillion and dividend to ¥200

MUFG.headline: Mitsubishi UFJ: half-year profit up 26% on rising Japanese rates; full-year target raised to ¥2.8 trillion and dividend to ¥100

NBIS.headline: Nebius: revenue up 571% to $981 million and a $466 million EBITDA profit, but data-centre delays and a $27 billion spending plan sink the shares

NTES.headline: NetEase: game revenue slips 1.7% and EPS misses by 12% as no new hit arrives; shares fall 11% with Ananta two months away

NU.headline: Nu Holdings: revenue up 39% and profit up 39% to $1.09 billion, as Mexico becomes a full bank; credit costs rise 71%

NVDA.headline: Nvidia: revenue doubled to $115.8 billion, yet the shares fell — the guide implies a lower gross margin

OXY.headline: Occidental: adjusted EPS of $1.91 beats by 29% and debt falls to $10 billion, clearing the way for bigger shareholder returns

P.headline: Everpure (formerly Pure Storage): revenue up 51% on AI and hyperscaler demand; full-year guidance raised for the third time

PANW.headline: Palo Alto Networks: next-generation ARR up 66%, guidance ‘materially’ raised, and a move into AI models

PBR.headline: Petrobras: record output of 3.51 million barrels a day lifts profit 22%, but earnings miss forecasts and spending rises sharply

PDD.headline: PDD: flat revenue but profit held at RMB31 billion as marketing cuts offset Temu’s shrinking commissions; shares up 11%

RKLB.headline: Rocket Lab: record $268 million revenue and backlog up 52% to $3.6 billion on $1 billion of new launch deals; shares jump 18%

ROIV.headline: Roivant: first drug launch brings $31 million in five weeks, and three clinical wins in one quarter; $4.2 billion of cash

ROST.headline: Ross Stores: comparable sales up 8% on rising traffic and EPS of $1.91 tops guidance; full-year outlook raised to $8.75–$8.84

SE.headline: Sea Limited: revenue up 43% and Shopee orders up 26%, but heavier marketing and credit provisions cap profit; shares slide

SKYD.headline: Skydance: first report after swallowing Warner Bros. Discovery shows Paramount+ revenue up 21% and a $6 billion savings target

SMFG.headline: Sumitomo Mitsui: half-year profit up 7.5% to ¥1.0 trillion; full-year forecast set at a record ¥1.9 trillion after a 2-for-1 split

TDG.headline: TransDigm: sales up 23% with 14% organic growth and a 53% EBITDA margin; 2027 guidance points to adjusted EPS of about $47.50

TGT.headline: Target: traffic up 5% and comparable sales up 5.6% — the turnaround is showing in the numbers

TJX.headline: TJX: comparable sales up 4% and above plan, with the stock up 8% on a stronger holiday outlook

TTWO.headline: Take-Two: bookings fall 18% in the quiet before GTA VI, as pre-orders reach “unprecedented levels” ten days from launch

VG.headline: Venture Global: record LNG sales lift EPS to $0.96, nearly double forecasts; Plaquemines starts long-term contracts and EBITDA guidance jumps 14%

VIK.headline: Viking: low water on Europe’s rivers cuts occupancy and EPS misses, but 2027 bookings are 17% ahead and the shares rise 4%

WDAY.headline: Workday lifts its margin and subscription outlook as AI products bring in nearly $150 million of new contract value

WMT.headline: Walmart’s third quarter: profit grew three times faster than sales, and the full-year outlook went up again

WSM.headline: Williams-Sonoma: every brand grows, comparable sales up 5.1%, and EPS up 12% to $2.19 once tariff refunds are stripped out

ZS.headline: Zscaler grows revenue 20% with record free cash flow, and agrees to be acquired by CrowdStrike
